keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (Atlético San Luis).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Atlético San Luis).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Atlético San Luis).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Leonardo Rodríguez (Juárez) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Atlético San Luis).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Atlético San Luis 0, Juárez 0.
Second Half begins Atlético San Luis 0, Juárez 0.
Substitution, Juárez. Jairo Torres replaces Madson.
Aldo Cruz (Atlético San Luis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Juárez. José Luis Rodríguez replaces Guilherme Castilho.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Leonardo Flores replaces Rafa Llorente.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Johan Caicedo replaces Felipe Mora.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Sebastián Pérez Bouquet replaces Anderson Duarte.
Eder López (Juárez) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Robson Bambu (Atlético San Luis) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Atlético San Luis 0, Juárez 1. Óscar Estupiñán (Juárez) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Santiago Muñóz replaces David Rodríguez.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Román Torres replaces Aldo Cruz.
Substitution, Juárez. Ricardo Juárez replaces Óscar Estupiñán.
Substitution, Juárez. Monchu replaces Eder López.
